# TinyCld — account brief

## Who
TinyCld is a GitHub organization at github.com/tinycld ([source](https://github.com/tinycld)). The evidence does not say what the company builds or sells.

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in the `tinycld/tinycld` repo ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in that repo lists react-native 0.83.6 ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 14 public repos and 67 followers ([source](https://github.com/tinycld)).
- `tinycld/tinycld` last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld)).

## Who to talk to
- Nathan Stitt (@nathanstitt), top contributor to `tinycld/tinycld` with 1378 commits ([source](https://github.com/nathanstitt)). His GitHub profile lists company `@safeinsights`, location Missouri, and website http://nathan.stitt.org ([source](https://github.com/nathanstitt)).
- Stefan N (@stefnnn), contributor to `tinycld/tinycld` with 4 commits ([source](https://github.com/stefnnn)). His GitHub profile lists location Switzerland ([source](https://github.com/stefnnn)).

## Why now
`tinycld/tinycld` last pushed on 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld)) and runs react-native 0.83.6 ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/main/package.json)). The evidence has nothing on store release cadence, so recency here is repo activity only.

## Suggested opener
Nathan, you have 1378 commits to `tinycld/tinycld`, the most of any contributor ([source](https://github.com/nathanstitt)). The repo carries an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside its own CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/tinycld/tinycld/tree/main/.github/workflows)). Which parts of the build and release path do those workflows own today, and which parts already run through EAS?
